invariants.name: test_ECON001_property_fullWindowDistribution_hourlyPokes / testFuzz_ECON001_pathIndependence
invariants.description: Over one depletionDuration with no new funding the pool should distribute ~100% of the funded stable regardless of interaction cadence. It does not: distribution is monotonically worse in poke count (re-anchor on every _updatePool).

invariants.name: test_ECON001_singlePoke_distributesFull
invariants.expectation: PASS (single late poke catches up to ~100% via cap-by-rewardBalance)
invariants.description: Confirms the intended Linear-Depletion endpoint is only reachable with exactly one poke per window.

invariants.name: test_ECON003_property_noOverMint
invariants.expectation: FAIL (phUSD minted exceeds the APY-implied cap)
invariants.description: Reward phUSD minted to a staker must not exceed stake*APY*timeStaked. pause->pauseWithdraw->unpause leaves phUSDPerSecond stale and lastRewardTime frozen, over-minting by factor S0/S1.

invariants.name: invariant_ECON003_no_over_mint
invariants.expectation: FAIL (global reward phUSD minted exceeds fair APY integral)
invariants.description: Stateful: cumulative reward phUSD minted by the contract must stay <= the time-integral of totalStaked(t)*APY (the fair APY emission). Broken on the pause/pauseWithdraw/unpause path.

invariants.name: test_CODE002_partialPauseWithdraw_thenClaim_reverts
invariants.expectation: PASS asserting the revert (confirms account brick) + principal recoverable via re-pause
invariants.description: After a PARTIAL pauseWithdraw the user's claim/withdraw/stake underflow-revert (debt anchored to the larger pre-withdraw amount); principal is recoverable only while paused.

invariants.name: invariant_CODE002_no_pending_underflow
invariants.expectation: FAIL (pendingPhUSD/pendingStable underflow for a partially-paused account)
invariants.description: For every staked account the pending arithmetic amount*acc/PRECISION - debt (shared by _claimRewards and pendingX views) must never underflow.

invariants.name: invariant_INV1_totalStaked_eq_sum
invariants.description: totalStaked == sum of userInfo[u].amount across all actors.

invariants.name: invariant_INV3_stable_solvency
invariants.description: rewardBalance <= rewardToken.balanceOf(contract); distributed stable is capped by rewardBalance.

invariants.name: invariant_acc_monotonic
invariants.description: accStablePerShare and accPhUSDPerShare are monotonic non-decreasing.
